purpose: Teach: 栄誉/誤字/身辺/原資/無形/物欲/申し込む/差し出す

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、創業時、社員に栄誉を与える経営をされた
lines.en: When Dad founded the company, he built his management around honoring his staff.
lines.style: Measured, reflective opening. Slight pause before naming the father—a gesture of respect. Warm but formal, the tone of someone recalling a principle that shaped a life. No rush.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは契約書の誤字を徹底排除された
lines.en: Yes. Father was meticulous about every detail—even the typos in contracts.
lines.style: Quiet affirmation. Small nod in the voice. Speaking from lived memory, not recitation. The specificity of 'typos' carries weight—a small thing that meant something. Steady regard.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、身辺整理を晩年大事にされた
lines.en: As he grew older, he saw to his affairs with real intention.
lines.style: Gentle, observant tone. A pause before 'grew older'—acknowledging the weight of time. Not sad, but touched by the care he witnessed. Slow pace. The voice of someone watching someone they love put their house in order.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは創業原資を自ら捻出された
lines.en: Yes. He found the capital himself, from the beginning.
lines.style: Firm but not proud. Speaking fact without embellishment. The 'Yes' carries quiet acknowledgment of sacrifice. Steady breath. A son recognizing his father's self-reliance.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、無形の信用を最重視された
lines.en: He cared most about trust—the kind you can't write down.
lines.style: Thoughtful pause before speaking. Soft on 'trust'—the word itself seems to matter to him. Slow, deliberate pace. The voice of someone who inherited an invisible thing and learned its value too late to tell him so.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは物欲よりも社員愛だった
lines.en: Yes. He loved his staff more than he wanted anything for himself.
lines.style: Simple statement, delivered with quiet certainty. No performance. The contrast between 'staff' and 'himself' lands gently. Breath at the end—a small exhale of recognition.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、新規取引を申し込む際は丁寧だった
lines.en: When he approached new business partnerships, he was always thoughtful.
lines.style: Precise, observant tone. The word 'thoughtful' carries deliberation—not just politeness, but actual care. Slight warmth. The voice recalling a pattern of small courtesies that added up to character.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは手を差し出す経営をされた
lines.en: Yes. He reached out to people. That's how he led.
lines.style: Quiet resolution. The metaphor of 'reaching out' lands softly—it's not showy, it's human. Slight hitch in the breath, like the son is still understanding what his father did. Final words steady, clear, closing the thought with respect.
